aboutPage.metaDescription: Why Mountaliq exists: the digital economy skills gap it closes, and the model behind the Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills.
aboutPage.heroTitle: A real opportunity. A real skill.
aboutPage.heroBody: Mountaliq is the Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills. Training that creates direct job opportunities, and a platform to showcase skills and take on freelance work. It exists because the internet has become a source of work in its own right, and because free content and scattered courses aren't enough to turn that opportunity into actual income.
aboutPage.stat1Label: Hands-on training tracks across e-commerce, marketing, content, and tech
aboutPage.stat2Label: Sectors in the digital economy, from affiliate marketing to paid AI services
aboutPage.stat4Label: Hours of hands-on training led by working specialists
aboutPage.internetEmployerBody: The global digital economy, from freelancing to e-commerce, affiliate marketing, and paid AI services, doesn't require a degree, connections, or major capital. Just a skill, a phone, and an internet connection.
aboutPage.freeContentTitle: Free content is a starting point, not a business plan
aboutPage.freeContentBody: What's freely available online is theoretical and scattered. Mountaliq takes each participant from theoretical knowledge to a sellable skill, and a product or service ready for the market.
aboutPage.modelTitle: Built to outlast its own funding.
aboutPage.modelBody: Mountaliq is a self-sustaining annual summit, with an Amman plenary that funds and anchors a hands-on training week. Once the model is proven, it's built to expand to other cities and governorates.
aboutPage.forTraineeBody: A marketable skill in days, not months, and a real product or project ready to sell by the end of training. After training, every participant moves directly into the Mountaliq marketplace to start working and land their first clients.
aboutPage.forPartnersBody: An annual Arab platform that links your name directly to a new generation of digital economy workers, with measurable impact: number of trainees, income generated, and projects actually launched.
aboutPage.forSectorBody: A tested, repeatable model that can be scaled to other cities and governorates once proven.
aboutPage.plenaryBody: The annual Mountaliq plenary in Amman, panels, keynotes, and digital economy practitioners in one room, one day.
aboutPage.trainingBody: A hands-on training week in Amman, in partnership with Jordan Bromine Company, across seven digital income tracks.

tracksPage.metaDescription: Seven digital income tracks across e-commerce, marketing, content, and tech, taught hands-on in Amman.
tracksPage.heroBody: Pick one track. Spend a week building the skill, the product, and the first client or sale that makes it real.

tracksData.title: E-commerce & Online Selling
tracksData.body: Trainees set up a real store, source or list products, and learn the cash-on-delivery workflows that make or break online selling in Jordan. By the end of the week, the store is ready to trade.

tracksData.title: Affiliate Marketing
tracksData.body: No inventory and no upfront capital. Trainees learn to pick offers, build an audience, and track commissions through platforms that actually pay out in Jordan.

tracksData.title: Content Creation & Monetization
tracksData.body: From short-form video to written content, trainees learn how each platform pays, and leave with a content system they can keep running after the week ends.

tracksData.title: Freelancing & Remote Services
tracksData.body: Trainees build a portfolio, set up a profile on global freelance platforms, and set their pricing and offer in design, writing, translation, and other in-demand remote services.

tracksData.title: Digital Products
tracksData.body: One product, sold endlessly. Trainees design and prepare a template, guide, or mini-course, and build a storefront to sell it without repeated effort.

tracksData.title: AI-Assisted Coding (Vibe Coding / No-Code)
tracksData.body: No computer science degree required. Trainees use AI tools and no-code platforms to ship a real app or automation by the end of training.

tracksData.title: Paid AI Services
tracksData.body: Trainees learn to turn AI capabilities, automation, content generation, and conversational support, into services they can pitch and sell to local businesses.

summitPage.title: The Arab Summit for Digital Economy Skills
summitPage.subtitle: Hands-on training in modern internet skills
summitPage.body: Participants go through a full rotation across four hands-on tracks, led by specialists actively working in these fields. Every participant leaves with something ready to work with in at least one track: a store, a content channel, a client pipeline, or a live AI-powered service.
summitPage.participantsSub: Participants, grouped for full rotation across all tracks
summitPage.day1Body: 9:00 opening plenary, sponsor and government addresses, then training rotation across Affiliate Marketing, E-commerce, AI & Vibe Coding, and Sales Skills through 16:40.
summitPage.day2Body: Training rotation continues from 9:30, closing with certificate handover and sponsor recognition at the 16:00 graduation ceremony.
